entities.name: mechanical pain sensitization after mustard oil

relationships.subject: Neanderthal Nav1.7 variants
relationships.object: mechanical pain sensitization after mustard oil
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that Neanderthal ancestry in SCN9A is significantly associated with a lower mechanical pain threshold after sensitization with mustard oil and evidence of additivity of effects across Nav1.7 variants.

relationships.subject: mustard oil
relationships.evidence_quote: Mustard oil activates the cation channel TRPA1 (which responds to environmental irritants29) expressed on nociceptors so sensitizing these neurons.

key_findings: Neanderthal SCN9A introgression tracts in Latin Americans are of Native American origin and overlap M932L, V991L and D1908G.
Neanderthal Nav1.7 variants are associated with lower mechanical pain threshold after mustard oil sensitization, with additive effects across variants.
